title: Words to read and colour: Reading three- and four-letter words without spelling out
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 2: An-Nasr, Al-Kafirun and reading joined words
source: Written for quran/y1 lesson 35 (Pupil PDF worksheet: words to read and colour)
intro: Lesson 35. Read each word slowly to a grown-up, then colour the part we learned today (Reading three- and four-letter words without spelling out). Then trace and copy.

panels.title: Look, slide, say
points: Slide through it in your head

questions.q: Pupil PDF: read eight short words in one go; tick each one you read without spelling out. The teacher listens to today's group.
Extend: time yourself reading the eight words with a grown-up.
questions.a: A time written on the sheet.
A) lakum. لَ (la) كُ (ku) مْ (m): lakum.

questions.q: Think again: Good readers do not spell out every letter. How do you think they do it?
questions.a: Their eyes look at the whole word and they slide through it; practice makes it quick.
